lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to use “ask and wait” and the answer reporter to personalise a story and let the reader choose what happens next.
“ask and wait” shows a question and a typing box.
The script waits until the reader types and presses enter.
Whatever the reader typed is stored in the blue “answer” reporter.
Join it to other words to use it in a sentence.
Use if-else with the answer to make the story branch: different answers lead to different scenes.
Never ask readers for private information like their address, phone number or school.
A first name or a choice is enough.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
